integrity: Symbolic identity and finite numerical checks accompany an analytic all-parameter proof; no external independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for two-state one-way generators and the displayed first-order forward-Euler product; larger-timestep endpoint positivity does not imply accuracy, internal-stage positivity, or broad solver stability. Priority against undiscovered equivalent special cases remains uncertain.
title: Reentrant endpoint positivity for a palindromic Euler splitting of two-state Markov generators
